_comment: The refusal set — every negative case is a NAMED refusal a DBA can self-serve (the error-contract law). Each case: a minimal delta from F1's accepted snapshots + the exact expected refusal.

cases.delta: simemr manifest/captured db = 'OTHERDB' (not in any registration)
cases.expect_refusal: INTAKE-8: db 'OTHERDB' is not registered; registration prerequisite lists: SIMDB

cases.delta: manifest declares SIMDB but the script-captured db name is 'SIMDB_TEST'
cases.expect_refusal: INTAKE-9: declared 'SIMDB' vs captured 'SIMDB_TEST' — both values named

cases.graph_effect: nothing written — the WHOLE extract refuses (atomic), not just the table

cases.expect_outcome: A14 RULED: group quarantined + counted; load proceeds; DBA ALERTED BY NAME in the intake report (the HITL form — a surfaced question, not a wall, not a silent skip)
cases.graph_effect: extract accepted; fk group 2 absent from joins_to; quarantine row + DBA alert in the intake report

cases.delta: columns.csv gains a row for table 'GHOST' absent from tables.csv
cases.expect_refusal: LC-C3: orphan column dbo.GHOST.X — refused + counted, not half-created

cases.delta: org extract declares a table in schema dbo (owned by simemr per the registration mapping)
cases.expect_refusal: INTAKE-8 (schema mapping): schema 'dbo' is not mapped to source 'org'
cases._witness: the source-inheritance rule enforced at the door
